title: Title Charge Schedule for a Mortgage Loan File: Commitment Age at Closing
content:
For a corrected Closing Disclosure on a Mortgage Loan File, the title line is measured in calendar days from the most recent document date among the cleared title commitment conditions on the file to the scheduled closing date. The document date is the date printed on the commitment supplied to clear a condition; where several title commitment conditions have been cleared, the most recent of their document dates is the one measured.

**Schedule.**

| Age of the commitment on the scheduled closing date | Title line |
|---|---|
| more than 180 days | a new commitment, priced at 1.10 USD for every thousand dollars of the base loan amount, rounded to the cent |
| more than 90 days but no more than 180 days | a date-down endorsement at the flat fee of 75.00 USD |
| no more than 90 days | nothing |
| no cleared title commitment condition on the file | nothing |
| no scheduled closing date on the file | nothing |

**Clause.** A commitment more than 180 days old must be replaced by a new commitment, priced at 1.10 for every thousand dollars of the base loan amount and rounded to the cent; a commitment more than 90 but no more than 180 days old is brought down by a date-down endorsement at the flat 75.00 USD; a commitment no more than 90 days old, or a file with no cleared title commitment condition or no scheduled closing date, adds nothing.

The new-commitment price is the base loan amount divided by one thousand and multiplied by 1.10, the product rounded to the cent; it is proportional and not rounded to whole thousands.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

- Base loan amount 412345.00 USD, commitment 181 days old: 412345.00 divided by 1000 is 412.345; multiplied by 1.10 that is 453.5795, rounded to 453.58 USD.
- Commitment exactly 180 days old: date-down endorsement, 75.00 USD.
- Commitment 91 days old: date-down endorsement, 75.00 USD.
- Commitment exactly 90 days old: nothing.
